channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Alemanha contribuirá com 500 milhões de euros para Fundo Clima, diz Lula
item.description: Germany will contribute 500 million euros to the Climate Fund, administered by BNDES, as announced by President Lula during a press conference with Chancellor Friedrich Merz. The amount, equivalent to approximately US$588.3 million, aims to support climate change mitigation and adaptation efforts in Brazil.

item.title: Na Alemanha, Lula nega turbulência em cenário eleitoral e diz estar 'tranquilo' para disputar quarto mandato
item.description: President Lula stated he is calm about running for a fourth term, denying electoral turbulence and defending democracy and national self-determination. He also criticized U.S. interventions in Venezuela and Cuba, calling for respect for territorial integrity and the UN Charter. The Quaest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) technically leading with 42% against Lula’s 40% in a potential 2026 runoff.

item.title: PT morde STF após Lula soltar mão do 'companheiro' Moraes
item.description: The Workers' Party publicly criticized the Supreme Federal Court after President Lula reduced his support for Justice Alexandre de Moraes. The shift comes amid the Master case, which overburdened the decision-making processes of the government and the party. The PT now includes in its agenda the demand for stricter ethical standards for the STF.

item.title: Em Hannover, Lula defende imigração diante de chanceler alemão criticado por declarações
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defended immigration during a speech at the Hannover Industrial Fair in Germany, alongside German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, who has previously faced criticism for anti-immigration statements. Lula emphasized immigration as a key issue in European and global elections, countering restrictive narratives.

item.title: “Taxação do Pix é ideia do Bolsonaro”, diz Haddad
item.description: Former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad (PT), a pre-candidate for governor of São Paulo, accused former President Jair Bolsonaro (PL) of being the originator of the Pix taxation idea. He also attempted to link President Lula (PT) to the extrajudicial liquidation of Banco Master, decreed by the Central Bank in November 2025.

item.title: O mundo não pode ser dirigido por mentiras, diz Lula na Alemanha
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva attended the Hannover Messe in Germany, advocating for multilateralism and criticizing the spread of fake news, stating that 'the world cannot be led by lies'. He warned about the dangers of the digital revolution and disinformation, implicitly referencing authoritarian tendencies without naming Donald Trump. His schedule includes the Brazil-Germany economic meeting, high-level intergovernmental consultations, a visit to Wolfsburg, and concludes in Lisbon to discuss the new nationality law and bilateral cooperation.

item.title: Girão critica inclusão de Zema em inquérito das fake news
item.description: Senator Eduardo Girão (Novo-CE) harshly criticized the potential inclusion of former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema in the Supreme Court's fake news inquiry, calling the move 'shameful'. He accused STF ministers of partisanship and using the inquiry to persecute political opponents. Girão argued that the inquiry is being weaponized for political persecution rather than combating disinformation.

item.title: O fator que divide bolsonaristas sobre a possível candidatura de Ciro Gomes à Presidência
item.description: Bolsonaristas are divided on the possibility of Ciro Gomes running for president: some see him as a strategic ally to strengthen opposition to the PT in the Northeast and benefit Flávio Bolsonaro in Ceará, even without direct support; others view him as a valuable adversary to generate presidential clashes against Lula in debates. The invitation came from Aécio Neves (PSDB-MG).

item.title: Charge do JCaesar: 20 de abril
item.description: The JCaesar cartoon published on April 20, 2026, offers political humor about events in Brasília, involving the Brazilian Air Force (FAB) and current affairs. The illustration uses sarcasm to comment on recent government decisions, maintaining the artist's characteristic critical tone. It is part of VEJA's humor section, focusing on institutional satire.

item.title: Gilmar pede a Moraes para investigar Zema no inquérito das fake news por vídeo com sátira ao STF
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes requested that Minister Alexandre de Moraes investigate former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema for sharing a satirical video targeting the STF, which Mendes claims harms the Court’s honor and his personal reputation. The video, featuring puppets resembling Toffoli and Mendes, references a real decision by Mendes that annulled secrecy breaks in Toffoli’s company. Zema, who left office to run for president, has intensified criticism of the STF, proposing a new Supreme Court if elected.

item.title: Produção de biocombustíveis não impacta produção alimentar, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that biofuel production in Brazil does not impact food production, rejecting the European criticism based on the ILUC concept. He emphasized that Brazil has over 40 million hectares of degraded land that can be restored to produce both food and biofuels without encroaching on native vegetation. Lula dismissed European concerns as a 'mythology' and asserted that no one would replace food production with biofuels.

item.title: Lula volta a defender biocombustíveis ao abrir Feira de Hannover e reclama de regulação europeia
item.description: Lula defended Brazilian biofuels at the Hannover Industrial Fair, arguing that food should not be replaced by fuel. He criticized European regulations that, he claims, hinder Brazilian biodiesel exports. Brazil is the guest country at the 79th edition of the event.

item.title: Lula defende agro e pede para alemães não crerem em 'mitos' sobre biocombustíveis
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defended Brazilian agribusiness during an event in Brasília, emphasizing the sector's importance to the national economy. He urged Germans not to believe 'myths' about biofuel production, stating that Brazil produces sustainably and efficiently. Lula stressed the need for international cooperation based on facts, not prejudice.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes aciona Zema no inquérito das Fake News, após vídeo postado nas redes
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes filed a criminal complaint against former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema, a Novo party presidential candidate, after Zema shared an AI-generated deepfake video depicting Mendes in a fictitious conversation with Dias Toffoli about the Banco Master scandal. Mendes claims the video harms his reputation and that of the Court, requesting investigation under the fake news inquiry. Reporter Alexandre de Moraes forwarded the case to the PGR, and the process remains under seal.

item.title: Lula cita 7 a 1 ao abrir discurso na Alemanha: “Que não se repita”
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva referenced Brazil's 7-1 loss to Germany in the 2014 World Cup while opening the Brazil-Germany Economic Meeting in Hannover, expressing hope that such a result would not be repeated in the 2026 World Cup. He urged private sector support to convert the provisional EU-Mercosul agreement into a permanent pact, calling it an essential instrument for the economies of Europe and South America.

item.title: Lula pede engajamento da Europa para vigência do acordo Mercosul-UE
item.description: President Lula called for European and private sector engagement to turn the provisional validity of the Mercosul-EU trade agreement into permanent, noting it enters into force on May 1. He emphasized the deal as essential for improving Brazilian trade and delivering benefits to workers, businesses, and consumers amid a turbulent global environment.

item.title: Visita à Alemanha prova que a sustentabilidade é arma da diplomacia econômica
item.description: President Lula visited Hannover Messe in Germany to defend the sustainability of Brazilian agriculture and criticize barriers to biofuels, highlighting the country's clean energy matrix as a strategy to improve Brazil's international image and expand business amid the oil crisis and the imminent entry into force of the Mercosul-European Union agreement. He was backed by business leaders and politicians who see the environmental agenda as an opportunity for economic diplomacy.

item.title: Na Alemanha, Lula defende biocombustíveis brasileiros e critica regras ambientais da União Europeia
item.description: Lula defended Brazilian biofuels in Germany, emphasizing their low CO₂ emissions and Brazil’s potential to lead the global energy transition. He criticized EU environmental regulations for overlooking Brazil’s sustainable practices, such as renewable energy use in ethanol and biodiesel production, warning that these rules could hinder clean energy access for European consumers despite Brazil’s proven efficiency.

item.title: Marinha prevê R$ 1,4 milhão em transporte a militares nas eleições
item.description: The Brazilian Navy estimates spending R$ 1.4 million on river transport of military personnel using small boats called 'voadeiras' during the 2026 elections in the Amazon region. The boats, contracted in 32 lots, will move troops from the 5th Jungle Infantry Battalion to remote riverside communities as part of the Voting and Counting Guarantee Operation (GVA). The vessels must carry up to 12 passengers and 1.2 tons of cargo, with safety equipment and navigation capability in narrow waterways.

item.title: Gilmar quer Zema no inquérito das fake news
item.description: Supreme Federal Court Justice Gilmar Mendes requested, via a crime-report, that fellow Justice Alexandre de Moraes include former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) in the fake news investigation. The request was forwarded to the Attorney General's Office and remains confidential, as is customary. The information was reported by Folha de S.Paulo and reposted by O Antagonista.

item.title: Título de eleitor: prazo para tirar ou regularizar vai até 6 de maio
item.description: Voters have until May 6, 2025, to obtain, update, or regularize their voter registration, or risk being unable to vote in the 2026 elections, with the first round scheduled for October 4. The process can be completed in person at electoral courts or Justice Electoral posts, or online via the TSE’s Self-Service Electoral Portal, though biometric collection requires an in-person visit. Required documents include a photo ID proving Brazilian nationality, a recent proof of residence, and, for men turning 19, proof of military service completion.

item.title: Gilmar pede a Moraes para incluir Zema em inquérito das Fake News
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes requested that former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema be included in the Fake News Inquiry, alleging that a video depicting Mendes and Justice Dias Toffoli as puppets with sophisticated editing vilifies the honor of the STF and serves personal promotion. The video, released last month, simulates dialogues between the two justices using puppet representations.

item.title: Caiado defende Kassab como vice e articula chapa do PSD para 2026
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD's pré-candidate for President, defended Gilberto Kassab, the party's national president, as a potential vice-presidential running mate for the 2026 ticket. The statement was made during an event in Guaratinguetá, São Paulo, at the Santuário de Frei Galvão. Caiado is working to build a competitive PSD slate for the 2026 presidential elections.

item.title: Na Alemanha, Lula diz que o multilateralismo está sendo destruído
item.description: President Lula defended multilateralism at the inauguration of the Brazilian booth at the Hannover Industrial Fair in Germany, warning that the post-World War II global harmony is being undone by rising unilateralism. He emphasized strengthening Brazil-Germany relations, envisioning a productive and envied partnership, and discussed energy transition (noting Brazil’s 30% ethanol in gasoline and 15% biodiesel in diesel) and migration, framing Brazil as a refuge. Lula made a strong appeal for peace, construction, and the defense of life, implicitly criticizing dehumanizing trends without naming specific countries or leaders.

item.title: Escala 6x1: propostas no Congresso avançam para pôr fim à jornada; veja qual está mais perto de passar
item.description: Congress is simultaneously analyzing four proposals to end the 6x1 work schedule, with the most advanced being PEC 148/2015, which calls for a gradual reduction of the workweek from 44 to 36 hours. The Chamber’s CCJ issued favorable reports on PEC 8/2025 and Reginaldo Lopes’ proposal, while the Lula government sent a constitutional urgency bill. In the Senate, PEC 148/2015 awaits plenary analysis after CCJ approval.

item.title: Três Graças: confira resumo da semana da novela das nove
item.description: In the week of the novela das nove 'Três Graças', Viviane and Leonardo reunite after his hospital discharge and move in together, while Arminda fails to find Edilberto's phone and the document proving Rogério's ownership of the Three Graces. Samira returns to Brazil with a fake passport and threatens Ferette, revealing he is her father, as Lucélia confesses her crimes, including drug trafficking in Chacrinha and threatening a cousin with a gun. Ferette is shunned by his sons, Kasper abandons the Three Graces under Bagdá's influence, and Zenilda kisses Rogério, spending the night with him.

item.title: Aliados do governo pedem mudança no mote ‘6x1’ dizendo que ninguém entende a ideia
item.description: Allies of President Lula are urging a change in the slogan '6x1' for the bill to reduce the workweek, arguing that the term is not understood by the public. The proposal aims to cut the workweek from 44 to 40 hours and guarantee two paid rest days per week without salary reduction, positioning it as a key issue in Lula's reelection campaign.

item.title: Feriado de São Jorge no Rio de Janeiro: 34 eventos para curtir na cidade
item.description: On São Jorge’s holiday (April 23), Rio de Janeiro celebrates with 34 events featuring feijoadas, samba shows, and cultural performances, highlighting artists such as Jorge Aragão, Belo, Leci Brandão, and Dudu Nobre. The program spans multiple city zones, from North to South, offering both free and paid options that blend religious, Afro-Brazilian, and popular traditions. Highlights include feijoadas at samba school venues, performances at the Folklore Museum, and vegan events in Botafogo.

item.title: Programa do PT que defende reforma do Judiciário amplia a tática do governo para tentar se blindar de crise no STF
item.description: The PT plans to include guidelines for a judicial reform in its party platform as part of a strategy to distance itself from the crisis involving the STF, particularly amid the Master case investigations and declining poll numbers. The proposal will be presented at the party’s 8th National Congress this week. The goal is to shield the party from institutional backlash while maintaining a discourse of independence from the Judiciary.

item.title: Tornozeleira rosa: Projeto de lei busca padronizar monitoramento de acusados de violência contra a mulher
item.description: A bill proposes pink electronic anklets for domestic violence offenders to help women identify aggressors and stigmatize them. It would amend Law No. 15.383/2026, which already establishes electronic monitoring as a protective measure, and could be applied during the initial accusation phase, as sanctioned by President Lula in May 2026.

item.title: Gilmar pede a Moraes que Zema seja investigado no inquérito das fake news
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes forwarded a criminal complaint against former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) to Minister Alexandre de Moraes, requesting Zema be included in the fake news investigation. The procedure is confidential and under judicial secrecy. Zema, an ally of the current Minas governor, has been accused of spreading disinformation during electoral campaigns.

item.title: Por que Lula deve renunciar à candidatura
item.description: The article argues that Lula should renounce his 2026 candidacy to maintain coherence with his 2022 promise not to seek a fourth term. It claims Lula won in 2022 by a narrow margin (2.1 million votes) with support from independent voters and a reduction in blank/null votes, forming a 'swap' that demands adherence to his word. Renouncing would benefit Brazil and Lula’s legacy.

item.title: Impostos aumentam para todos
item.description: The Minister of Institutional Relations, José Guimarães, opposes the 'blusinhas' tax, while Vice President Geraldo Alckmin supports it. President Lula has not taken a direct stance in the internal government dispute but suggested he may support abolishing the tax. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Haddad diz que “taxação do Pix” foi ideia de Bolsonaro
item.description: Fernando Haddad claimed that the idea to tax Pix came from former President Jair Bolsonaro, and that the liquidation of Banco Master is a merit of Lula’s government. He made the statement in an X post on April 19, 2026, reigniting the debate over alleged Pix taxation under Lula. The controversy stemmed from a September 2024 Federal Revenue Service rule requiring reporting of transactions over R$ 5,000, which was later revoked due to public backlash.

item.title: Lula ressuscita espantalho do neoliberalismo e revela inveja do bolsonarismo
item.description: Lula claims the global left has succumbed to neoliberalism, practicing austerity despite progressive rhetoric, thereby creating space for Bolsonarism to present itself as anti-system. He acknowledges his 2022 victory stemmed from anti-Bolsonaro sentiment, not a strong leftist program, and views his centre alliance as an ideological misstep. This self-criticism reveals a hint of envy toward the Bolsonarist ability to mobilize through anti-establishment discourse.

item.title: Flávio bate em Lula, ligando-o ao Master; Haddad reage
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused Lula of being linked to Banco Master, claiming the Pix was created under Bolsonaro's government and Banco Master under Lula's. The statement was made on social media, prompting a reaction from Haddad, though the full article is subscriber-only. The attack aims to associate the president with alleged financial misconduct.

item.title: PT quer juros de 1 dígito e reformas no Judiciário e Forças Armadas
item.description: The PT is formalizing its party program for Lula’s 2026 re-election bid, emphasizing an expanded state role, reforms to the Judiciary and Armed Forces, and proposals such as list voting, ending binding amendments, and a progressive tax reform. Coordinated by José Dirceu, the document includes criticism of U.S. foreign policy under Trump and advocacy for ending the Cuba embargo, alongside self-criticism regarding union weakening, evangelical influence, and social media challenges.

item.title: Na Alemanha, Lula defende parceria com Europa na descarbonização
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva advocated at the opening of Hannover Messe in Germany for a Brazil-Europe partnership to decarbonize industry and promote a clean energy matrix. He criticized barriers to biofuel access, emphasized commitments to green economy and Industry 4.0 by 2026, and warned about the ethical risks of artificial intelligence in military targeting and labor markets.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro lança filme para apresentá-lo ao eleitor
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign is launching a short film on social media to introduce him to the electorate, aiming to shape public perception through marketing strategies. The 'filmete' seeks to portray how the campaign wants him to be viewed by Brazilian voters. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Os cálculos do PT ao pegar carona na chapa de Eduardo Paes ao governo do Rio
item.description: The PT has officially endorsed Eduardo Paes (PSD) as its candidate for governor of Rio de Janeiro, abandoning plans to field its own candidate due to a lack of competitive options in the state, considered a bolsonarist stronghold. The alliance aims to leverage Paes’s popularity to improve Lula’s performance in the state, where he lost to Bolsonaro in 2022. Benedita da Silva will run for Senate on the ticket, and the PT hopes Lula’s support will also benefit Paes among left-leaning voters.

item.title: Haddad adota tom de campanha ao se reapresentar a eleitores em vídeos
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT’s pre-candidate for governor of São Paulo, posted campaign-style videos on social media reintroducing himself to voters, highlighting his personal and public trajectory, including his Lebanese roots, life in São Paulo, and policies such as ProUni, Enem, and income tax exemption for those earning up to R$5,000. He stressed that his candidacy aims to build a strategic platform in the country’s largest electoral college, with direct impact on the 2026 presidential election, after initially resisting the idea and yielding to Lula’s request.

item.title: PT se reúne para incorporar 'reforma do Judiciário' a programa partidário
item.description: The PT plans to incorporate judicial reform directives into its party program, including ethical codes for superior courts like the STF and internal accountability mechanisms, while preserving judicial independence. The move comes amid the Master case investigation and concerns that opposition figures may exploit controversies involving ministers such as Dias Toffoli and Alexandre de Moraes to undermine Lula’s 2026 re-election bid. Drafted by a commission led by José Dirceu, the proposal links judicial reform to democratic strengthening and warns against the politicization of justice.

item.title: Flávio relembra jingle de Bolsonaro de 2014
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro reposted on his X profile a campaign jingle used by Jair Bolsonaro in the 2014 elections, when the former president was the most voted federal deputy from Rio de Janeiro running for the PP. The post, with the caption 'Straight from the time tunnel!', aims to remind and mobilize the Bolsonarist base ahead of the 2026 elections, emphasizing the continuity of the family's political legacy.

item.title: Sem Bruno Henrique, veja escalação do Flamengo para duelo contra Bahia
item.description: Flamengo will face Bahia this Sunday (April 19) at 7:30 PM at Maracanã for the 12th round of the Brazilian Championship. Bruno Henrique starts on the bench, while Gonzalo Plata is named starter despite recent criticism over his behavior. Flamengo sits in second place with 20 points, nine behind leaders Palmeiras, and aims to extend its 32-year unbeaten home record against Bahia.

item.title: Maquiador de Michelle sobre Flávio: “Esse estereótipo nunca chegou à Presidência”
item.description: Agustin Fernandez, a close friend of former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro and her makeup artist, told Iron Studios he does not believe in the success of Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential pre-candidacy, stating the senator struggles to connect with lower-income voters and that his profile limits his electoral potential.

item.title: Mulher de Flávio o chama de “Bolsonaro moderado”
item.description: Fernanda Bolsonaro, wife of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), described him as a 'moderate' version of former President Jair Bolsonaro, claiming she 're-educated' him. The video, posted on April 19, 2026, highlights a campaign strategy to position Flávio as a conciliatory candidate while retaining his father’s base and appealing to centrist voters. Flávio echoed the electoral tone, speaking of accelerating Brazil’s future and walking on its own legs.

item.title: Erosão do bolso ajuda a explicar o mau humor do eleitor com Lula
item.description: Brazil's economy grew above 3% for three consecutive years until 2024, with real gains in labor income, but in 2025 GDP slowed to 2.3%, contributing to a sense of eroding purchasing power and voter dissatisfaction despite positive income trends. This perception of relative stagnation helps explain discontent with Lula's government, even amid accumulated growth.

item.title: Lula volta a criticar Trump: ‘Mundo não pode se curvar a presidente que faz guerra pelo Twitter’
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) sharply criticized U.S. President Donald Trump during his speech at the Hannover Fair in Germany, accusing him of using Twitter to impose sanctions, tax products, and wage wars without regard for humanitarian consequences. Lula advocated for strengthening democracy, multilateralism, and respect for national sovereignty, questioning the effectiveness of the UN Security Council amid global conflicts and highlighting the contradiction between technological progress and indiscriminate violence against civilians in the Middle East.

item.title: Coritiba aproveita falhas e vence Atlético-MG no Brasileirão
item.description: Coritiba defeated Atlético-MG 2-0 at Couto Pereira in the 12th round of the Brasileirão, ending a four-match winless streak. Breno Lopes scored in the 6th minute of the first half, and Pedro Rocha added the second in the second half. Atlético-MG suffered their second consecutive loss in the tournament.

item.title: Na Alemanha, Lula critica 'narrativas falsas' sobre agronegócio brasileiro
item.description: At the Hannover Messe in Germany, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) criticized the European Union for spreading 'false narratives' about Brazilian agribusiness, noting that the sector largely does not politically support his administration.
